entities.name: CTP synthase
observations: Sequence is 549 aa and matches reviewed bacterial CTP synthases at ~69–70% identity across ~98% query coverage (E-value ~10^-273 to 10^-276).
Likely catalyzes ATP-dependent conversion of UTP to CTP using glutamine-derived ammonia or ammonia directly (EC 6.3.4.2).
Sequence contains CTP_synth_N (PF06418; aa 4–266) and GATase (PF00117; aa 301–533) domains.

entities.name: De novo CTP biosynthesis
observations: CTP synthase carries out the terminal amination step in de novo CTP biosynthesis, contributing to pyrimidine nucleotide metabolism.

entities.name: UTP-to-CTP reaction
observations: Candidate reaction: UTP + L-glutamine + ATP + H2O → CTP + L-glutamate + ADP + phosphate + 2 H+ (Rhea:26426), as annotated for close homologs.
